note: The full randomized report gives post-treatment Geriatric Depression Scale mean ranks 11.98 for the aqueous tulsi–cardamom blend and 29.03 for green tea, 20 older adults per arm. U=29.5 and Z=−4.634, reported p<.001. The product contained both plants, and the report estimates a post-treatment rank contrast rather than a between-group change. It supplies no isolated ground cardamom or Parkinson depression estimate.

Figure 2 shows lower forced-swim immobility for oral Nigella sativa seed extract than reserpine alone, approximately 2.1 versus 3.6 minutes by graph reading, with different significance letters. Six rats per group. The preparation is an ethanol seed extract rather than toasted seed. No independent general locomotor control is reported, and the study does not estimate Parkinson depression in people.
